jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

jobs.description:
What to Expect

We are scaling our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operations into the German energy market and are looking for a hands-on VPP Operations Specialist – Germany to support that growth from day one. We need someone who can roll up their sleeves, own exceptions end-to-end, and bring deep practical knowledge of how the German energy market operates at a process and regulatory level.You will be embedded in our Operations team, working closely with our flexibility, settlements, and support functions across the globe. A key part of your role will be upskilling our support staff on German market workflows, participant journeys, and exception handling – ensuring the whole team can operate confidently as we grow our German footprint.

What You’ll Do

Market Operations

- Apply working knowledge of the German energy regulatory landscape (BNetzA, BDEW) to day-to-day operational tasks.
- Manage and resolve data flow exceptions relating to MaKo/EDIFACT messaging, GPKE, and WiM processes, and MSB/VNB interactions.
- Support the accurate management of MaLo and MeLo data, ensuring data integrity across systems.
- Work within the MsbG metering framework and support smart meter rollout processes relevant to VPP-connected assets.
- Demonstrate solid understanding of MaBis processes.
- Monitor Bilanzkreis and settlement obligations relevant to our flexible asset portfolio in Germany.Flexibility Participant & Exception Management
- Act as the primary handler for escalated exceptions arising from the German flexibility participant journey – from asset registration through to settlement and payment queries.
- Own complex cases end-to-end, coordinating across internal teams (settlements, tech, finance) to reach resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and escalate systemic root causes with clear data and recommended fixes.
- Support onboarding of new German flexibility participants and asset owners, ensuring a smooth and compliant process.Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Design and deliver structured training sessions for UK-based support staff covering German market processes, regulatory obligations, and participant workflows.
- Build and maintain clear, practical playbooks, process guides, and FAQs for use by the wider support team.
- Conduct regular knowledge gap assessments and adjust training content accordingly.
- Review training effectiveness and iterate based on team performance and feedback.Process Improvement & Efficiency
- Actively identify manual or repetitive tasks and find ways to reduce effort through process redesign or tooling.
- Maintain up-to-date process documentation in a clear, accessible format.
- Flag regulatory or process changes in the German market that may impact operations and recommend responses.

What You’ll Bring

Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical working knowledge across most of the following:

- BNetzA regulatory framework and BDEW market rules
- MaKo communication standards and EDIFACT message types
- GPKE (supplier switching) and WiM (metering point management) processes
- MsbG obligations and the role of the Messstellenbetreiber (MSB)
- MaLo (market location) and MeLo (metering location) data structures
- Bilanzkreis management and balancing group settlement
- German electricity billing structures including Netzentgelte and Grundversorgung vs. competitive supply frameworks
- Direktvermarktung framework
- MaBis processes for balancing group settlement reconciliation
- FCR/aFRR/mFFR prequalification and flexibility market participation rules (desirable)Essential
- Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), with experience communicating with German counterparts and producing documentation in both languages
- Demonstrable hands-on experience working within the German energy market at an operational level (a minimum of 3 years)
- Proven ability to manage exceptions and complex operational cases end-to-end
- Experience designing and delivering training or knowledge transfer programmes
- Strong analytical mindset with a practical, solutions-first approach
- Comfortable working autonomously and picking up tasks without needing close directionDesirable
- Experience with MaKo-compliant systems or EDIFACT messaging tools
- Knowledge of MSB obligations and smart meter rollout processes in Germany
- Experience working across multiple European energy markets
- Experience in a scale-up or market entry environment
